items.title: Take-Two (NASDAQ:TTWO) reports sales below analyst estimates in Q3 CY2026 earnings
items.summary: Video game publisher Take Two (NASDAQ:TTWO) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q2 2027), with revenue falling 23.6% year on year to $1.5 billion. Next quarter’s revenue guidance of $3.35 billion underwhelmed, coming in 3.7% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Its GAAP loss of $0.29 per share was 66.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
